Phone : 0761-266 1336 Website : www.jupiterwagons.com e-mail : corporate@jupiterwagons.com Press Release Jupiter Wagons to manufacture metro trains and propulsion systems in India through joint venture with Korea’s Woojin Industrial Systems 80:20 joint venture brings complete technology transfer for metro coaches and for propulsion systems serving metro, EMU, Vande Bharat, semi-high-speed and high-speed trains, completing JWL’s rail portfolio from the wheels to the traction motor National, November 23rd 2026: Jupiter Wagons Limited (JWL) (NSE: JWL | BSE: 533272), one of India’s leading rail and mobility manufacturers, has entered into a joint venture with Woojin Industrial Systems Co., Ltd. (Woojin) of the Republic of Korea, a respected name in railway propulsion, train control and metro rolling stock with more than five decades of engineering heritage. JWL will hold 80 per cent of the joint venture and Woojin will hold 20 per cent. The joint venture marks JWL’s entry into two of the most technology-intensive segments of rolling stock: complete metro coaches and propulsion systems. It will manufacture entire metro coaches in India together with all their critical components from Woojin’s portfolio, including Propulsion Systems, Train Control and Management Systems (TCMS), automatic door systems, bogies and aluminium car body shells. Propulsion, the electrical system that powers, controls and regeneratively brakes a modern electric train, sits at the heart of every electric trainset. Beyond metro, the joint venture’s propulsion systems will serve the wider spectrum of India’s electric trains, including Vande Bharat trainsets, Electric Multiple Units (EMUs), and semi-high-speed and high-speed trains. Ready for India’s metro era India’s metro story has grown from a handful of cities into a national movement. New lines are opening in state capitals and fast-growing cities, while established networks extend their reach to meet rising ridership. Operators increasingly seek trains that are lighter, more energy efficient, more automated and built in India. Thanking You, For Arkade Developers Limited Amit Mangilal Jain Chairman & Managing Director DIN: 00139764 Encl: As above ARKADE STRENGTHENS ITS SOUTH MUMBAI FOOTPRINT WITH LANDMARK REDEVELOPMENT TARGETING ~1500 Cr GDV IN TARDEO ~2-acre redevelopment project with a projected Gross Development Value (GDV) of ₹1,500 crore reinforces Arkade’s growth ambitions in one of Mumbai’s most prestigious real estate markets. Mumbai, 23rd November 2026: Arkade Developers, leading luxury listed real estate developers in Mumbai, has announced its strategic re-entry into the coveted South Mumbai (SoBo) real estate market with an ambitious redevelopment project in Tardeo, marking a significant milestone in the company's growth journey. Building on its existing presence in Mazagaon, Altamount Road and Carmichael Road, Arkade is further expanding its footprint across South Mumbai’s premium residential landscape. The redevelopment project is spread across approximately 2 acres and is expected to have a projected Gross Development Value (GDV) of ₹1,500 crore, as a significant addition to Arkade’s redevelopment portfolio. The project underscores the company’s confidence in the long-term potential of South Mumbai and its commitment to identifying high-value redevelopment opportunities in established micro-markets across the city. Tardeo, renowned for its central location, established social infrastructure, premium residential character and excellent connectivity, continues to remain one of Mumbai’s most sought-after residential destinations. With limited availability of developable land and sustained demand for quality residential spaces, the micro-market presents compelling opportunities for thoughtfully conceptualized redevelopment. Arkade’s return to South Mumbai represents more than a geographic expansion; it reflects a strategic step towards strengthening its presence in Mumbai’s premium real estate landscape. Leveraging its experience in residential development and redevelopment, the company aims to unlock the potential of well-established urban locations through projects that combine contemporary aspirations with the enduring value of prime addresses. Speaking on the acquisition, Mr. Amit Jain, CMD of Arkade Developers, said: Our re-entry into South Mumbai is an important strategic milestone for Arkade. Tardeo represents the very essence of Mumbai's premium residential landscape, offering a rare combination of location, legacy and long-term value. This project reflects our confidence in the redevelopment potential of established neighborhoods and our ambition to create meaningful value in some of Mumbai's most sought-after locations. Titagarh has also started taking steps to manufacture a prototype wagon for these auto carriers in order to offer shorter delivery timelines to the customers. Transfer of Tubes Business of the Company and entering into Business Transfer Agreement between the Company and APL Apollo Tubes Limited Considered and approved the transfer of the business of manufacturing, processing, marketing, sale and distribution of steel tubes and pipes at and from the steel tubes manufacturing facilities of the Company at Jamshedpur, Hosur, Khopoli and Sahibabad, in each case, including products manufactured directly by the Company or through contract manufacturing arrangements, and certain cold rolling and surface coated steel product facilities at Khopoli, together with all related plants, facilities, operations and activities ancillary or incidental thereto (‘Tubes Business’) of the Company to APL Apollo Tubes Limited (‘APL Apollo’), as a going concern on a slump sale basis for a lump sum consideration of up to ₹11,700 crore.
